summary: Payment Manager project (frontend) with UI components imported via @/components/ui/* alias.
architectural_notes: Frontend uses path alias @/ (e.g., @/components/ui/*) for shared UI components.
known_issues: Build fails due to missing UI components directory: unresolved imports for @/components/ui/{sonner,button,card,badge,alert-dialog,dialog,input,label,textarea,select,radio-group,alert}.

existing_features.title: Resolve the build error caused by missing imports under `@/components/ui/*` by replacing all such imports across the frontend with imports from a new, non-immutable local UI kit directory (for example `@/components/ui-kit/*`).

Remove the dependency on the missing `@/components/ui/sonner` wrapper by switching to a working Toaster import and usage, ensuring toast notifications continue to display (the app currently calls `toast.success`/`toast.error`).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create the missing UI component implementations in the new UI kit directory to match the APIs currently used by the app: `button`, `card`, `badge`, `alert`, `dialog`, `alert-dialog`, `input`, `label`, `textarea`, `select`, and `radio-group` (including the subcomponents referenced in the code, such as `CardHeader`, `DialogContent`, `SelectItem`, etc.).
